data.name: TerraFixing
data.description: TerraFixing is an Ottawa-based direct air capture startup founded in 2021 by two University of Ottawa chemical engineers, developing zeolite-based DAC technology optimized for cold, dry northern climates. The company aims to fit a 1,000 tonnes/year capture unit into a shipping container at below $100/tonne, and is deploying its first units with Tugliq Énergie in northern Quebec.
